correctness.rationale: For fixed f, the level holding times G_s are independent geometric(1/2), mean 2 variance 2. Kolmogorov convergence plus Kronecker imply J^-1 sum f(s)(G_s−2)→0; the final incomplete hold is o(n), and S_n/n→1/2, proving n^-1 sum f(S_j)−A_floor(n/2)(f)→0 almost surely. Predictable brackets for the bounded martingale differences (ξ_j,f(S_{j−1})ξ_j) therefore converge to [[1,ρ],[ρ,1]], giving the FCLT including ρ=±1. Necessity follows from the previously established bootstrap Brownian-bracket necessity and deterministic averages on even n. For the Pascal signs, Lucas submask differences yield |E fβ(s)fβ(t)|≤q^(2^(w(t)−1)), and entropy counting gives E A_N²=O(N^(-1/8)); Borel–Cantelli on floor(j^10) and bounded interpolation give the quenched spatial law. Independent finite Lucas-mask check covered all 32,640 pairs s<t<256. No finite check substitutes for the almost-sure or functional limit arguments.

final_claim: For fixed ±1 scenery f counted by negative inputs, diffusive bootstrap (X,Y) has Brownian correlation ρ exactly when spatial Cesàro averages A_N(f)→ρ; almost-sure occupation/spatial identity holds without scenery convergence. Independent uniformly nondegenerate Pascal-parity coefficients have A_N→0 a.s., giving a quenched limit with independent Brownian coordinates.
